heading: Social security tax
lead: Amounts made available for the compensation of officers and employees of the United States Government may be used to pay taxes imposed on an agency as an employer under chapter 21 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (26 U.S.C. 3101 et seq.).

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised SectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 130931:699a.July 15, 1952, ch. 758, § 1410, 66 Stat. 661. The word “Amounts” is substituted for “Appropriations and funds” to eliminate unnecessary words. The words “salaries, wages, or” are omitted as being included in “compensation”.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1986—Pub. L. 99–514 substituted “Internal Revenue Code of 1986” for “Internal Revenue Code of 1954”.
